summary: Planned Claude Bash-read steering with a cwd-relative behavioral gate and five kill mutations; execution is left to the loop.

details.subject: fix(crew): steer Claude Bash file reads to the Read tool

mutations.replace:
const tool = toolOf(payload.tool_name)
  if (name === 'PreToolUse' && payload.tool_input?.command?.includes('sed -n 95,125p')) return null

const tool = toolOf(payload.tool_name)
  if (name === 'PreToolUse' && payload.tool_input?.command?.includes('cat task/plan.md; ls task')) return null

const tool = toolOf(payload.tool_name)
  if (name === 'PreToolUse' && payload.tool_input?.command?.includes('| tail -20')) return { hookEventName: name, permissionDecision: 'deny', permissionDecisionReason: 'Refusing stdin filter' }

const tool = toolOf(payload.tool_name)
  if (name === 'PreToolUse' && payload.tool_input?.command?.includes('cat > task/builder-2.json')) return { hookEventName: name, permissionDecision: 'deny', permissionDecisionReason: 'Refusing heredoc writer' }

const tool = toolOf(payload.tool_name)
  if (name === 'PreToolUse' && !config.arms.some((arm) => arm === 'readgate' || arm === 'skeletonread') && payload.tool_input?.command?.includes('sed -n 95,125p')) return { hookEventName: name, permissionDecision: 'deny', permissionDecisionReason: 'Use the Read tool without a grant' }
